verdict.rationale: Cua is computer-use agent infrastructure, so how it locates UI elements is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence documents its element-locating approach: no accessibility tree, OCR, set-of-marks or coordinate grounding. The only related item is a community report naming an 'OMNI loop' and describing typing in the wrong place, which shows misclicks happen but does not document how targets are located or how to debug them.
